verdict.rationale: HubSpot Workflows provide rule-based automation triggered by CRM events (docs-12, docs-45), and webhooks/APIs allow event-driven integrations (docs-4), plus MCP server access for AI agents to read/write CRM data (docs-5, docs-30, docs-40). However, evidence shows no native AI-defined 'if-this-then-that' natural-language rule builder for an AI-native user specifically—automation is mostly manual workflow-builder based, not AI-native rule authoring.
